headlines.title: Soleo Health Selected as a Specialty Pharmacy Partner for Pasatru™, a New Treatment in Adults with Fibrodysplasia Ossificans Progressiva
headlines.summary: FRISCO, Texas, Nov. 10, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Soleo Health, an innovative leader and national provider of complex specialty pharmacy services, announced today that it was selected as a specialty pharmacy partner for Pasatru™ (garetosmab-grts), Regeneron’s FDA-approved product to reduce formation of new heterotopic ossification (HO) lesions and clinician-assessed flare-ups in adults with fibrodysplasia ossificans progressiva (FOP), an ultra-rare genetic disorder.

headlines.title: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals (REGN) Extends BARDA Deal As Libtayo Long Term Data Holds Up
headlines.summary: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals (NasdaqGS:REGN) reported new long-term Phase 3 data for Libtayo in high-risk cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma. The trial readout highlighted sustained disease-free and overall survival outcomes in patients treated with Libtayo adjuvant therapy despite high crossover rates. Regeneron expanded its U.S. government agreement with BARDA for additional Inmazeb supply to support infectious disease preparedness efforts.

headlines.title: Mary Tyler Moore Vision Initiative Welcomes Regeneron and Adaptive Sensory Technology to Its Consortium
headlines.summary: The Mary Tyler Moore Vision Initiative (MTM Vision) today announced that Regeneron Pharmaceuticals, Inc. has joined the MTM Vision Consortium as a founding member and Adaptive Sensory Technology as a device company member.

description: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals, Inc. discovers, invents, develops, manufactures, and commercializes medicines to treat various diseases worldwide. The company develops product candidates to treat eye, allergic and inflammatory, cardiovascular, metabolic, neurological, infectious, and rare diseases; and cancer, hematologic conditions. It also offers EYLEA injections for wet age-related macular degeneration and diabetic macular edema; myopic choroidal neovascularization; diabetic retinopathy; neovascular glaucoma; retinopathy of prematurity; Dupixent injection to treat atopic dermatitis and asthma; Libtayo injection for metastatic or locally advanced cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma; Praluent injection to treat heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia (HoFH); and Kevzara solution for rheumatoid arthritis. It has license and collaboration agreement with Bayer for the development and commercialization of EYLEA 8 mg and EYLEA; Alnylam Pharmaceuticals, Inc. to discover, develop, and commercialize RNAi therapeutics for diseases by addressing therapeutic disease targets expressed in eye and central nervous system; Intellia Therapeutics, Inc. to advance CRISPR/Cas9 gene-editing technology for in vivo therapeutic development for therapies focused on neurological and muscular diseases; Hansoh Pharmaceuticals Group Company Limited to acquire development and commercial rights for HS-20094, a dual GLP-1/GIP receptor; and Tessera Therapeutics, Inc. develops and commercializes TSRA-196, an investigational gene editing therapy for Alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency. The company has a strategic collaboration with Telix Pharmaceuticals Limited to develop and commercialize radiopharmaceutical therapies. It also has a strategic collaboration with CytomX Therapeutics, Inc. to create conditionally-activated bispecific cancer therapies. It has a strategic alliance with Sanofi to develop long-acting immunology antibodies. The company was incorporated in 1988 and is based in Tarrytown, New York.
